decisions: Install flag is notes-detective.demo.seeded in localStorage behind an injectable store; the flag is set when seeding succeeds and when it is skipped for existing cases.
Seed image generation happens only after the flag and zero-case checks; a failed generation or transaction leaves the flag unset so a later clean boot can retry.
The case, six cards, five strings, and twelve attachments commit in one read-write Dexie transaction, with attachments last so a failed Blob write rolls back the whole graph.
removeDemoCase rejects non-demo cases with DomainValidationError and re-marks the flag after a successful delete; generic confirmed delete remains safe because the seed flag is already durable.
The demo is left ready-to-close rather than closed; the five specified strings derive topic 1 as solved (2 notes) and topic 2 as developing (1 note).

payload.taskDescription: Create demoImages.ts to draw two note pages and two source pages locally on canvas at 1200x800, producing original, display, and thumbnail Blobs with no external assets. Create demoCase.ts with two notes, two sources, two topics, and five connections: note 1 to source 1 and note 2 to source 2 as provenance; note 1 to topic 1, note 2 to topic 1, and note 1 to topic 2 as associations. This must be close-ready with topic 1 solved and topic 2 developing. Create seedDemoCase.ts to write the case and attachments atomically only when no cases exist and the install-level demo flag is unset; set the flag even if seeding is skipped. Use the existing isDemo field on the case model. Add tests for the graph shape, readiness, image generation, one-time behavior, removal without reseed, and isDemo surviving an export/import round-trip. Do not add UI.
